ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, a right-angle triangle plate is stacked in the manner shown. Where $ \angle A=45^\circ$ and $ \angle D=30^\circ$. If $ DF\parallel BC$, then what is the degree measure of $ \angle AGE$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution}: Since $\triangle ABC$ and $\triangle DFE$ are both right-angled triangles, with $\angle A=45^\circ$ and $\angle D=30^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle B=45^\circ$ and $\angle DFE=90^\circ-30^\circ=60^\circ$,\\
since $DF\parallel BC$ and $\angle D=30^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle FEC=\angle DFE=60^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle GEB=90^\circ-\angle DFE=90^\circ-60^\circ=30^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle AGE=\angle GEB+\angle B=30^\circ+45^\circ=\boxed{75^\circ}$,

Thus $\angle AGE=\angle GEB+\angle B=30^\circ+45^\circ=\boxed{75^\circ}$.
ready3_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: As shown in the figure, a right-angle triangle plate is stacked in the manner shown, where $\angle A=45^\circ$ and $\angle D=30^\circ$. If $DF\parallel BC$, then what is the degree measure of $\angle AGE$?
ready3_open_rewrite.resolved_answer: Since $\triangle ABC$ and $\triangle DFE$ are both right-angled triangles, with $\angle A=45^\circ$ and $\angle D=30^\circ$, thus $\angle B=45^\circ$ and $\angle DFE=90^\circ-30^\circ=60^\circ$. Since $DF\parallel BC$ and $\angle D=30^\circ$, thus $\angle FEC=\angle DFE=60^\circ$. Thus $\angle GEB=90^\circ-\angle DFE=90^\circ-60^\circ=30^\circ$. Thus $\angle AGE=\angle GEB+\angle B=30^\circ+45^\circ=\boxed{75^\circ}$.
ready3_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure, the large triangle ABC is a right triangle, with the right angle at C; A is at the upper left, C is at the lower left, B is at the lower right, and E is on CB. The oblique line AB intersects the oblique line ED at G, and A, G, B are collinear, so GA is the extension direction of GB. There is a line segment FD above, and the problem statement gives DF ∥ BC; angle D is the angle formed by DF and DE. Reasoning: Because ΔABC is right-angled at C, and ∠A = 45°, therefore ∠B = 90° - 45° = 45°. Also because DF ∥ BC, and ∠D = 30° is the included angle between DE and DF, therefore DE and EB (on BC) form the corresponding acute angle ∠GEB = 30°. In triangle EGB, ∠EBG = ∠ABC = 45°. ∠AGE is the exterior angle of triangle EGB at point G, therefore ∠AGE = ∠GEB + ∠EBG = 30° + 45° = 75°.
